body: Build: admin 2FA control, unknown-device mail, stale accounts, security events and drains, graded actions, geo-blocking and impossible travel via a GeoIP interface, proof-of-work, email domain allow-list, LDAP module, SIWE module. Defer: OPAQUE, DBSC, EVP, USOS OAuth 1.0a, Nostr/NEAR/TON, Firebase/Strapi identity sources, devtools panel, inbox, analytics dashboard, hosted admin UI. Skip: CRM/marketing connectors (Dub, Attio, Sequenzy: a data hook is enough), GitHub-star gating, trial-abuse fingerprinting, hosted demo, docs chat, docs MCP server, videos.
